name: econ_6mt_overdrive
source: racing_game-owned economy 6-speed manual transaxle with a very tall overdrive sixth (0.58), an invented design, NOT a specific gearbox [AS]. Geared for the lowest engine speed at motorway pace: fifth 0.74 and sixth 0.58 are both overdrives, first 3.38; steps 1.72 / 1.50 / 1.35 / 1.31 / 1.28 (all under the 1.92 zero-throttle shift-hunting limit of the car files' auto-shift points). Mesh efficiency 0.97-0.985 per gear (economy box, as econ_5mt) [AS]. Synchro capacities, inertias and timings follow physics_sim's sedan_6mt (input-shaft-referred cone synchros, reverse without a synchro) [AS]. Torque rating 320 N*m is kept in data/gearboxes/gearbox_catalog.json.
